title: Проблеми зі зміною мови
body: Немає української мови, все на мові ворога - на російській. Коли змінюєш на англійську, то частина все одно залишається російською! І взагалі, якщо ви заходите на НЕ малий ринок України, то робіть додаток з українською мовою! Не розраховуйте на те, що ми і так знаємо ворожу мову соссійську! Дарма витратив час. Моя дитина не знає мову ворога російську, знає тільки українську і трохи англійську.

title: I live the app and experience but the connectivity issues are killing me
body: Great idea and great implementation. I’m playing Habitica for two month so far and it really has a positive impact on my habits! But.. The way this application lags sometimes on connecting server is very very frustrating. On stable and fast Wi-Fi connection I sometimes wait for up to 10 seconds for UI to respond. And sometimes I make a few actions with my tasks and it seems that it worked, but the connection resets and all actions reverted. So annoying!

title: One of the best Task Managers
body: Offers a really interesting perspective to analyze your life as a game, and helps to succeed in it! The best thing is that you can play with your friends, and with some paid features it can be really fun to watch yourself dealing with your life. Although there can be a couple of bugs in the app, and some features may be really missing - like just blank simple Notes page for additional commentary or habits status changes history - this app is still great with all its functionality, and you definitely should give it a try!
